name: @internal/github-sdk-fetch-rest-api
description: The one GitHub REST transport — request contract, auth, defaults, pagination, response and error contracts, cancellation and media types, on the platform's native fetch. Composes with @internal/github-sdk-ratelimit and owns no rate-limit logic.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --outDir dist/esm && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --module CommonJS --moduleResolution Node10 --outDir dist/cjs && node ../scripts/fixup-dist.mjs .

author: GitHub API Module
